home.title: Premium flooring and acoustic panels for Quebec professionals
home.lead: Pick your products, work out quantities or upload a floor plan. Our team replies with a detailed quote.
home.audience: Built for contractors, designers and architects. Every quote spells out price, taxes and delivery.
home.startCatalogText: Filter by tone, format and use. Each product page lists specs and technical documents.
home.startCalculatorText: Enter each room's dimensions, choose a waste allowance and get the number of boxes or panels.
home.startPlanText: We read the rooms and areas off your plan. You check them, then add everything to your quote.
home.planBandTitle: Send your plan. We measure the areas with you.
home.planBandText: Upload a PDF or a clear photo. Rooms and dimensions are read automatically. Correct anything that looks off, then add the areas to your quote.
home.planStep1: Upload the plan (PDF, JPG or PNG).
home.planStep2: Check each detected room and its area.
home.planStep3: Pick a product for each room and send your request.
home.how1Text: From the catalogue, the calculator or the plan reader. Quantities stay editable.
home.how2Text: Tell us about the project, the site location and how you want to receive the order. No online payment.
home.how3Text: By email within [time], with price, taxes and delivery.
home.ctaText: Send us your products and quantities. We'll reply with a detailed quote.
home.planAlt: Sample floor plan with three detected rooms: living room, kitchen and hallway.

calculator.title: Quantity calculator
calculator.lead: Add up your rooms, include waste and get the number of boxes or panels to order. Check the result with your installer.
calculator.wasteHelp: Straight lay often needs 5 to 10%. Diagonal or herringbone needs more. Confirm with your installer.
calculator.panelHelp: Listed on the panel's product page. Panels are counted whole; offcuts are not reused.
calculator.coverageMissingNote: Enter the coverage per box to get the number of boxes.
calculator.roundedUp: Rounded up to the next box.
calculator.panelsRounded: Whole panels per wall, rounded up.
calculator.errorDimensions: Enter a length and a width above 0, for example 12.5.
calculator.errorTooLarge: This dimension is above the calculator's limit. Contact us for large projects.

planReader.lead: Check the rooms read from your plan, pick a floor for each room, then add the areas to your quote.
planReader.uploadLead: Take a photo of your floor plan or choose a file. We read the rooms and their areas; you check them next.
planReader.takePhoto: Take a photo of the plan

planReader.tip3: Shot straight on, no glare or shadows.
